title: Ordinary evaluation compatibility descends for normalized tensor models
statement:
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)

variable (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ)
  (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)
  (target : Data.{c, v, r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)


theorem geometricTensorEvaluation [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (tensorPullback : A.closed.tensor ⋙ O.pull.mapDerivedCategory ≅
    (O.pull.mapDerivedCategory.prod O.pull.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ target.closed.tensor)
    (levelTensorPullback : ∀ n : ℕ,
    (A.levelClosed n).tensor ⋙
        derivedExact.{c, v, max c v r, c, v} J J' (B n)
          (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n).modules ≅
      ((derivedExact.{c, v, max c v r, c, v} J J' (B n)
          (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n).modules).prod
        (derivedExact.{c, v, max c v r, c, v} J J' (B n)
          (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n).modules)) ⋙ (target.levelClosed n).tensor)
    (levelTensorModel : ∀ n : ℕ,
    TensorComparisonModel.{c, v, r} J J' (B n) (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n).modules
      (A.levelClosed n) (target.levelClosed n) (A.levelTensorModels n)
        (target.levelTensorModels n) (levelTensorPullback n))
    (tensorModel : TensorComparisonModel.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
    (coefficientSequenceTopology J') (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ)
      (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition) O.pull A.closed
        target.closed
        A.tensorModels target.tensorModels tensorPullback)
    (tensor_ordinary_evaluation : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ),
    (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n).map
      (tensorModel.ordinary M N).hom ≫
      (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n (O.pull.obj M)
        (O.pull.obj N)).hom ≫
      ordinaryTensorHom.{c, v, r} J' (O.coefficients n)
        ((O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).hom.app M) ((O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).hom.app N) =
      (O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).hom.app
        (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J) (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J
          B τ) M N) ≫
      (O.inverseImage n).modules.map (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ n M N).hom ≫
      ((levelTensorModel n).ordinary ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M)
        ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj N)).hom)
    : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M P : DS.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ),
    (e.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n).map
        (tensorPullback.hom.app (M, P)) ≫
        (target.tensorEvaluation n).hom.app
          (O.pull.mapDerivedCategory.obj M, O.pull.mapDerivedCategory.obj P) ≫
        (target.levelClosed n).tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (((geometryPullEvaluation J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O) n).hom.app M)
            (((geometryPullEvaluation J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O) n).hom.app P)) =
      ((geometryPullEvaluation J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O) n).hom.app (A.closed.tensor.obj (M, P))
        ≫
        (derivedExact.{c, v, max c v r, c, v} J J' (B n)
          (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n).modules).map
            ((A.tensorEvaluation n).hom.app (M, P)) ≫
        (levelTensorPullback n).hom.app
          ((e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M, (e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj P)

Proof of the four-model square from its representative equations, using existing cochain tensor naturality helpers.

proof.text: Work first for four arbitrary exact additive module functors F,G,H,I and an ordinary square isomorphism θ : F⋙G ≅ H⋙I. A TensorComparisonModel preserves flat modules: put a flat module in degree zero, apply the bounded-above flat K-flat criterion and model.kflat, and use the converse K-flat single-complex criterion. Thus F and H send flat-term K-flat representatives to flat-term K-flat representatives, allowing the second model G or I to be applied.

proof.text: On every (p,q) summand of the source total tensor, substitute the four model.summand formulas and naturality of θ. Invert the assumed ordinary tensor square by composing with the inverses of its four tensor comparisons. The resulting equation, followed by the summand inclusion, proves equality of the two composite cochain comparisons by mapBifunctor.hom_ext and HomologicalComplex.hom_ext. The tensorSummand_map helper identifies the tensor of the θ components.

proof.text: Invert each model.derived equation and compose the equations for F and G, respectively H and I. Naturality of the second tensor comparison and of mapDerivedCategoryFactors gives the two composite normalization formulas. The factorization equation for mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and the composition-factorization equation identify the localized θ with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso.symm followed by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso θ and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Tensor-model naturality then transports the cochain square to the inverse derived square on localized flat-term K-flat representatives, cancelling invertible model and factorization comparisons.

proof.text: Package the two inverse-square routes as natural transformations on the product of the source derived category. Cochain tensor model rigidity makes restriction to flat-term K-flat representatives injective, so the previous equality holds everywhere. Cancel the inverse tensor comparisons to obtain the forward square. Specialize F to geometric pullback, G to target evaluation, H to source evaluation and I to coefficient-level inverse image; the ordinary parts of the two evaluation models are the recorded ordinaryEvaluationTensor maps, so the assumed ordinary evaluation square gives exactly the required hypothesis.
